notes: no rooms labelled; only checked that the design can be walked around
approximations: a door's approach: the cell beside it along its facing
passable blocks (torches, signs, carpets...) count as gaps
support = any non-passable neighbour; face sturdiness not modelled
flammability from wood/wool/leaf tags + a short list

build_order.json replayed block by block with eve-builder's rules (eve_design.placecheck): a standing spot reachable on foot (sturdy top, bottom slab or stair), a face within 4.3 of the eye (feet + 1.27), hit first by the ray, look matching the facing; standing in cells not yet built ('unbuilt')
scaffold blocks are taken as placeable; the click aims at face centres (body's place_block v2 may do better)
